quarterly_data.signal: Canaan authorized its management to monetize a portion of its digital asset treasury, depending on market conditions and working capital requirements. It said that, according to its June 2026 monthly production and mining operation updates, it held digital assets with an approximate market value of US$130 million based on prevailing market prices as of August 3, 2026. CEO Nangeng Zhang: 'Our operations continue to generate bitcoin, providing us with a flexible source of capital that we can deploy selectively and with discipline.'
